newsitem.title: IRAN: U.N. body approves more food aid for Iraqi Kurds.
newsitem.headline: U.N. body approves more food aid for Iraqi Kurds.

text.p: The United Nations food agency has approved 2.29 billion Iranian rials ($762,000 at official exchange rates) in food aid for Iraqi Kurds sheltered at Iranian refugee camps, the World Food Programme (WFP) in Tehran said in statement received on Thursday.

The 2,118 tonnes of wheat, rice, pulses, sugar and 86 tonnes of oil would be distributed by the end of the year to more than 40,000 Kurdish refugees at camps on the Iran-Iraq border, the statement said.

"Sufficient quantities are being released from the existing stocks for immediate distribution to the new refugees in the three affected provinces of West Azerbaijan, Kurdestan and Kermanshah," it said.
"The stocks so released will be replaced by WFP with shipments as soon as possible."
"As regards oil, efforts are being made to supply a small quantity from nearby countries on an urgent basis to meet immediate requirements," it said.
The U.N. body has delivered 110.5 tonnes of commodities, including 31.5 tonnes of oil, from WFP stocks in northern Iraq to meet the immediate needs of the refugees.
Recent fighting in northern Iraq between two rival Kurdish factions forced tens of thousands of Kurds to flee to the border camps.
